verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Signals pipeline turns matched events into Alerts via Alert Rules, Escalation Policies and On-Call Schedules, and Alerting Analytics tracks how alerts turn into incidents — implying some level of event-to-alert consolidation, but there is no explicit documentation of deduplication logic (e.g., merging duplicate/related alerts into a single alert or incident) to prevent alert storms. missing for 10: explicit dedup/grouping algorithm documentation, evidence of merging duplicate alerts, and independent/hands-on confirmation that one incident results from many correlated alerts.
